name: claude-desktop-mods
description: Unofficial mods for the Code tab of Claude Desktop

plugins.name: usage-pet
plugins.description: Usage band above the prompt (context / 5-hour / weekly / optional Fable weekly / cache hit) with Clawd, an animated pixel pet

plugins.name: doc-review
plugins.description: Offers a read-only Fable subagent review after a superpowers spec or plan is written

plugins.name: remote-sessions
plugins.description: Pane listing sessions with Remote Control on, close each with one click; /remote-sessions off [keyword] too

plugins.name: jira-link
plugins.description: Link Jira tickets to a session with /jira, auto-link keys from your prompts, and show them in a pane

plugins.name: zh-reply
plugins.description: Keeps conversational replies in Chinese; code, commits, PRs and tickets stay in English
